case_name: SaaS site missing meta + social tags

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="Acme SaaS is the smart project management platform built for growing teams. Collaborate, track progress, and ship faster — try it free today.">
fixes.fix_explanation: A meta description tells search engines and users what the page is about, appearing as the snippet in search results. This 150-character description includes relevant keywords and a clear call to action.
fixes.fix_location: Place inside the <head> element, after the <meta name="viewport"> tag.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:title" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:title tag controls the title displayed when the page is shared on social platforms like Facebook and LinkedIn. It mirrors the page title to ensure consistent branding across channels.
fixes.fix_location: Place inside the <head> element, after the meta description tag.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:description" content="Acme SaaS is the smart project management platform built for growing teams. Collaborate, track progress, and ship faster — try it free today.">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:description tag provides the summary text shown in social media link previews. A compelling description improves click-through rates when the page is shared on social platforms.
fixes.fix_location: Place inside the <head> element, directly after the og:title tag.

fixes.fix_code:
<meta property="og:image" content="https://acme-saas.com/images/og-image.png">
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
<meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
<meta property="og:image:alt" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:image tag defines the image displayed in social media previews when the page is shared. Use a 1200×630 px image for optimal display across Facebook, LinkedIn, and other platforms.
fixes.fix_location: Place inside the <head> element, directly after the og:description tag. Update the image URL to point to your actual Open Graph image file.

fixes.fix_code:
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Acme SaaS is the smart project management platform built for growing teams. Collaborate, track progress, and ship faster — try it free today.">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://acme-saas.com/images/og-image.png">
<meta name="twitter:image:alt" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
fixes.fix_explanation: Twitter Card tags control how your page appears when shared on Twitter/X, enabling a rich preview with a large image, title, and description. The summary_large_image card type provides maximum visual impact in the Twitter feed.
fixes.fix_location: Place inside the <head> element, directly after the og:image tags, before the closing </head> tag.
